full_judgment: 5. Mr. SK. Md. Sirajul Islam, appearing for the petitioners, submits that the High Court Division erred in not holding that though the SA Khatian was prepared in the name of the Government, but the RS Khatian No.478 was rightly prepared and published in respect of 40 decimals land in the names of the said two sons of Nikunja Sarker, i.e. Buddeshwar and Badal Chandra which proved that the SA Khatian was wrongly prepared in the name of the Government. He further submits that the High Court Division fell into error in not holding that taking advantage of the said wrong preparation SA Khatian, the Government gave pattan to one Mojibur Rahman on 11.11.1992 and the claim of the plaintiffs was that for getting rid of the said illegal pattan, the plaintiffs on 04.05.1994 purchased 20 decimals land in question from said Mojibur Rahman and thereafter, the plaintiffs purchased the said property from Buddeshwar on 18.05.1994 and instituted the original suit for declaration of title in accordance with law and that was supported by the evidence of PW1. The learned Advocate further submits that by adducing evidence PW2 proved the plaintiffs' possession over the suit land though the Government erroneously cancelled the lease deed in holding that the suit land had no legal value in the eye of law and the predecessor of the plaintiffs did not get title of the suit land.
